title: BIR Form No. 1600-WP — Remittance Return of Percentage Tax on Winnings and Prizes Withheld by Race Track Operators

validation.how: Labels turn red via has_error; messages render only in the card after Schedule II: body = body.child(self.section("Needs review", issues, cx)).

findings.now: The Day box opens already filled with 1, so the return can be queued for the 1st of the month without the filer ever typing a day.
findings.why: The official Day box starts blank and raises 'Please enter a valid day on Item 1.' (BIR-Form1600WP.hta:3175), but new_from_profile sets day to 1, so that alert can never fire for a default draft.

options.name: Start blank
options.detail: Leave Day empty until the filer types it, matching the official default and its alert.

options.name: Flag the default
options.detail: Keep 1 but mark it unconfirmed and block queueing until the filer edits it.

options.name: Use the tile's day
options.detail: Take the day from the library tile when it carries one, otherwise start blank.

findings.now: Editing Month or Year on an open draft makes Save write a second draft, and the draft from the tile keeps the old date.
findings.why: Drafts are keyed by TIN, year and the monthly period column (filing_period is Monthly(month)), so an edited month becomes a different row.

options.name: Lock the period
options.detail: Show Month and Year read-only once a draft exists, with a separate 'Start another month' action.

options.name: Move the same row
options.detail: On a month change, rekey the existing draft after a confirm step instead of inserting a second row.

options.name: Open the saved draft
options.detail: On a month change, load that month's saved draft, or create one, and say so in the status line.

findings.now: A TIN or RDO error shows only in Needs review, while the Item 5 and Item 6 rows are read-only and not highlighted.
findings.why: readonly() never calls has_error, and both values come from the profile, so the page offers no way to correct them.

options.name: Fix-in-profile link
options.detail: Show a 'Fix in profile' link beside Item 5 and Item 6 when either message applies.

options.name: Red read-only row
options.detail: Colour the read-only row red and place its message beside it.

options.name: Overridable field
options.detail: Let the filer correct Item 5 and Item 6 on the return, with the profile value as the default.

findings.now: Errors collect in a card below Schedule II, showing only the first 20, while Queue for submission at the top is greyed out with no message beside it.
findings.why: The message sits far from the controls that cause it, and errors past the 20th are dropped without a count (take(20) at form_1600wp_view.rs:1177).

options.name: Inline messages
options.detail: Show each message under its field and keep the red label.

options.name: Summary under toolbar
options.detail: Show a count with jump links directly under the toolbar, above the sections.

options.name: Full list
options.detail: Drop the 20-message cap, or show 'and N more' when it applies.

findings.now: Each of the ten Schedule II rows repeats its own pair of ATC chips, so the schedule shows twenty ATC chips above the totals.
findings.why: A single-value pick repeated on ten rows is clutter, and a per-row combobox keeps the ATC list check the official form applies (BIR-Form1600WP.hta:3328).

options.name: Combobox per row
options.detail: A compact type-to-filter picker per row that still offers only the category's two ATCs.

options.name: One table column
options.detail: A single table with an ATC column so the ten rows scan together.

options.name: Inline chips
options.detail: Keep the two chips but place them on the row's TIN and name line to save height.

findings.now: The header titles and Print preview button this page renders come from components/form_engine.rs, which commit cdb1a9b4 changed together with the shared event_form_kit.rs and the 1601C and 2550Q pages.
findings.why: Shared-file edits beyond one-line registrations break the rule that a form's change touches only its own files.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Ship the shared header change as its own reviewed commit.

options.name: Keep the header local
options.detail: Move this form's header into its own view file.

options.name: Drop other forms' edits
options.detail: Remove the 1601C, 2550Q and event_form_kit edits from this change and ship them separately.

findings.now: This form's Print preview depends on a frozen-sheet writer map added to shared bir-print code in commit 366af7e6, which also changed the 1606 model and view, the shared support-level registry and a generated manifest.
findings.why: A form's change should touch only its own files plus one-line registrations, and this commit goes well beyond that.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Ship the 1606 changes and the shared frozen-sheet code as separate reviewed commits.

options.name: One-line registration
options.detail: Keep only this form's slug and writer-map arm in shared code, with the sheet map in its own html-frozen folder.

options.name: Revert the 1606 edits
options.detail: Drop the form_1606 changes from this commit and land them with 1606's own work.
